# Data import 

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
# CONFIGURATION --------------- 
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(patchwork)

base_dir <- "/work/williarj/williarj/2627_HJH_Thesis/"
figure_folder <- paste0(base_dir, "scripts/r_analysis/Figures/")

# Test directory 
list.dirs(base_dir, full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE)

data <- data.frame()
data7 <- read.csv(paste0(base_dir, "data/outputs/experiment_7.csv"))
data8 <- read.csv(paste0(base_dir, "data/outputs/experiment_8.csv"))
data9 <- read.csv(paste0(base_dir, "data/outputs/experiment_9.csv"))
data <- rbind(data, data7)
data <- rbind(data, data8)
data <- rbind(data, data9)
rm(data7, data8, data9)
```

# Data manipulation

```{r}
# 1. Rename Q values 
data <- data %>% select(-q_value_pop2) # remove, and then decide if we need to 1-pop or now 

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    hybrid_status = case_when(
      str_detect(ind_id, "IND") ~ str_split_i(ind_id, "_", 2),
      str_detect(ind_id, "F1") ~ "F1",
      str_detect(ind_id, "BC2HYB") ~ "BC1HYB",
      str_detect(ind_id, "BC3HYB") ~ "BC2HYB",
      str_detect(ind_id, "BC4HYB") ~ "BC3HYB",
      str_detect(ind_id, "BC5HYB") ~ "BC4HYB",
      str_detect(ind_id, "BC6HYB") ~ "BC5HYB",
      str_detect(ind_id, "BC7HYB") ~ "BC6HYB"
    )
  )

# JC_orientation means pop1 == JC? -- doesn't necessary align with the BC2POP1 labels
data <- data %>%
  group_by(experiment_ID, bootstrap_ID, run_id) %>%
  mutate(
    JC_orientation = mean(
      q_value_pop1[hybrid_status == "JC"],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) > 0.5,
    
    JC = if_else(
      JC_orientation,
      q_value_pop1,
      1 - q_value_pop1
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Cateogrical 
```{r}
# Factor order of the data/categorical variables 
data <- data %>%
  mutate(hybrid_status = factor(
    hybrid_status,
    levels = c("JA", "F1", "BC1HYB", "BC2HYB", "BC3HYB", "BC4HYB", "BC5HYB", "BC6HYB", "JC")
  ))

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    experiment_ID = factor(
      experiment_ID,
      levels = c(7, 8, 9),
      labels = c("Random 500 loci", "Random 1000 loci", "Random 5000 loci")
    )
  )
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    bootstrap_ID = factor(bootstrap_ID)
  )
```

# Data validation
```{r}
# Combine both grouping variables inside a single group_by statement
summary_data <- data %>%
  group_by(experiment_ID, hybrid_status) %>%
  summarize(
    # mean_q_JA  = mean(JA, na.rm = TRUE),
    # sd_q_JA    = sd(JA, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_q_JC  = mean(JC, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_q_JC    = sd(JC, na.rm = TRUE),
    num_ind_per_class = n_distinct(ind_id),
    bootstraps = n_distinct(bootstrap_ID),
    str_runs_per_bootstrap = n_distinct(run_id),
    total_runs = n(),
    .groups    = "drop" # This automatically ungroups the data after summarizing
  )
output_csv_path <- file.path(paste0(base_dir, "data/outputs/summary_q_per_hybrid_class.csv"))
write.csv(summary_data, file = output_csv_path, row.names = FALSE)
```

# Density plots

## Formating
```{r}
hybrid_colors <- c(
  "JA" = "#ADD8E6",
  "F1" = "#87CEEB",
  "BC1HYB" = "#6495ED",
  "BC2HYB" = "#4169E1",
  "BC3HYB" = "#3155B5",
  "BC4HYB" = "#244494",
  "BC5HYB" = "#193575",
  "BC6HYB" = "#102653",
  "JC" = "#00008B"
)

# hybrid_colors <- c(
#   "JA" = "#808080",
#   "F1" = "#F8766D",
#   "BC1HYB" = "#C49A00",
#   "BC2HYB" = "#53B400",
#   "BC3HYB" = "#00C094",
#   "BC4HYB" = "#00B6EB",
#   "BC5HYB" = "#A58AFF",
#   "BC6HYB" = "#FB61D7",
#   "JC" = "#404040"
# )

hybrid_levels <- names(hybrid_colors)
```

## All data
```{r}
#data_zoom_in <- data %>% filter(JC > 0.75) %>% filter(experiment_ID == "5000_loci")
data_zoom_in <- data %>% filter(hybrid_status %in%  c("JA", "F1", "BC1HYB", "BC2HYB", "BC3HYB", "BC4HYB", "BC5HYB", "BC6HYB", "JC"))

q_density_plot_all <- ggplot(data_zoom_in, 
                         aes(x = JC, fill = hybrid_status, color = hybrid_status)) +
  geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(ndensity)), alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ experiment_ID, ncol = 3) +

  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) + 
  
  labs(
    #title = "Density Distribution of Q-values Across Experiments",
    x = "Ancestry, Q (1 = JC, 0 = JA)",
    y = "Normalized Density",

  ) +
  
  # Designated colors 
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = hybrid_colors,
    limits = hybrid_levels,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = hybrid_colors,
    limits = hybrid_levels,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
        aspect.ratio = 0.6, 
   axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      margin = margin(t = 0.5),
      size = 10
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      margin = margin(t = 5)
    ),
    
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    
    legend.position = "right",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank()
  )

print(q_density_plot_all)

ggsave(paste0(figure_folder, "random_loci_densities_all.png"), plot = q_density_plot_all, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```

# Combined

## Version 1
```{r}
q_density_combined <- 
  (q_density_plot_all +
     theme(
       axis.title.x = element_blank(),
       axis.title.y = element_blank(),
     )) /
  (q_density_plot_zoom_f1 +
     theme(
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none"
     )) / 
  (q_density_plot_zoom_bc2 +
     theme(
       axis.title.y = element_blank(),
       legend.position = "none"
     )) + 
  plot_layout(
    ncol = 1,
    heights = c(1, 1, 1),
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

q_density_combined
```

## Version 2

```{r}
library(cowplot)
library(grid)

p1 <- q_density_plot_all + theme(
  axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
  axis.title.y = element_blank())

p2 <- q_density_plot_zoom_f1 + theme(
  axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  strip.text = element_blank(), # removes the 500, 1000, 5000 labels from other rows
  legend.position = "none") # removes the repeat color legends 

p3 <- q_density_plot_zoom_bc2 + theme(
  axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
  strip.text = element_blank(), # removes the 500, 1000, 5000 labels from other rows
  legend.position = "none")

q_density_combined <- ( (p1 / p2 / p3) ) + 
  plot_layout(
    ncol = 1, 
    widths = c(1, 1, 1, 1),       
    guides = "collect"      
  ) & 
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) &
  plot_annotation(
    theme = theme(
    # Axis text
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),

    # Facet labels (500, 1000, 5000)
    strip.text = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),

    # Legend
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),

    # Axis ticks
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5)
  ))

q_density_combined

ggsave(paste0(figure_folder, "random_loci_densities_combined.png"), plot = q_density_combined, width = 18, height = 12, dpi = 300)
```
